body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card B uses the imperative/command form నడవండి (you walk) which is stiff and bossy toward an elder, rather than A's natural suggestion 11 నిమిషాల నడకతో అక్కడికి చేరుకోవచ్చు (we can reach there by an 11-minute walk).
